# lifechanger — AI automation for business (Ukraine)

> Yevheniia builds turnkey AI employees for small and medium businesses: agents
> that answer customers 24/7 in Telegram, Instagram and WhatsApp, sell, update
> the CRM and draft documents. Packages from $500 one-time, launch in 1–2 weeks,
> optional + support from $100/mo. Free discovery call runs inside the Telegram
> bot. Site languages: Ukrainian (default), Russian, English.

Prices below are one-time implementation fees in USD; the support plan is the
only recurring item. Exact quotes are given after a free discovery session.
Content updated 2026-11-05.

## Pages

- [Home — Ukrainian](https://ai-lifechanger.com/): services, pricing, agent builder, FAQ
- [Home — Russian](https://ai-lifechanger.com/ru/): the same page in Russian
- [Home — English](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/): the same page in English

## Services

- [AI assistant in messengers](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/#formats): answers customers 24/7 in Telegram, Instagram and WhatsApp, qualifies leads and books calls
- [Sales and CRM automation](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/#solutions): the agent sells, records deals in the CRM and reports to the owner daily
- [Documents and quotes](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/#solutions): proposals, invoices and contracts generated from a chat conversation
- [Pricing](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/#pricing): Light from $500 · Standard from $1,500 · Business from $3,000, one-time; + support from $100/mo
- [Agent builder](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/#configurator): pick a package and add-ons, see the total and the payback period
- [Delivery process](https://ai-lifechanger.com/en/#process): five steps from discovery to launch, 1–4 weeks depending on scope
